pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')

# Function to parse various datetime formats
def parse_datetime_flexible(dt_str, default_date=None):
    """Parse datetime string with flexible formats"""
    dt_str = str(dt_str).strip()
    
    # Try to match time only (HH:MM)
    time_only = re.match(r'^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$', dt_str)
    if time_only:
        hour, minute = time_only.groups()
        if default_date:
            return f"{default_date} {int(hour):02d}:{minute}"
        else:
            return f"{int(hour):02d}:{minute}"  # Return time only
    
    # Try full datetime (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
    full_dt = re.match(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$', dt_str)
    if full_dt:
        year, month, day, hour, minute = full_dt.groups()
        return f"{year}-{month}-{day} {int(hour):02d}:{minute}"
    
    # Try alternate format (MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM)
    alt_dt = re.match(r'^(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4}) (\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$', dt_str)
    if alt_dt:
        month, day, year, hour, minute = alt_dt.groups()
        return f"{year}-{month}-{day} {int(hour):02d}:{minute}"
    
    return dt_str

# Check semantic equivalence
print("=== Checking Semantic Datetime Equivalence ===")
semantic_matches = 0
mismatches = []

for i in range(len(ref_df)):
    ref_val = str(ref_df.loc[i, 'datetime'])
    pred_val = str(pred_df.loc[i, 'datetime'])
    
    # Parse reference (remove seconds if present)
    ref_parsed = ref_val.replace(':00', '')  # Remove seconds
    
    # Parse predicted
    pred_parsed = parse_datetime_flexible(pred_val)
    
    # For time-only predictions, we need to check if the time matches the reference time
    if re.match(r'^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$', pred_parsed):
        # Extract time from reference
        ref_time = ref_parsed.split(' ')[1] if ' ' in ref_parsed else ''
        if pred_parsed == ref_time or pred_parsed == ref_time.lstrip('0'):
            semantic_matches += 1
        else:
            mismatches.append((i, ref_val, pred_val, "Time mismatch"))
    elif pred_parsed == ref_parsed:
        semantic_matches += 1
    else:
        mismatches.append((i, ref_val, pred_val, "Full datetime mismatch"))

print(f"Semantic matches: {semantic_matches}/{len(ref_df)}")
print(f"Mismatches: {len(mismatches)}")

    print("\nFirst 10 mismatches:")

        print(f"  Row {idx}: Ref='{ref}' | Pred='{pred}' | Reason: {reason}")
